{{Quote|Your game style has lost none of its intrigue or charm, Lord Vader. We are glad that you could come to Cheelit and accept our challenge...|Lady Dhol, to Darth Vader|<ref name="DLC" />}}
'''Cheelit''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Cheelit system/Legends|Cheelit system]], located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Semagi sector/Legends|Semagi sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> along the [[Cerean Reach/Legends|Cerean Reach]].<ref name="TEA" /> Cheelit was home to the [[J'feh/Legends|J'feh]],<ref name="vegas" /> a race of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopods]] that lived within large, floating globes. Cheelit's ornate [[Hive Palace]] was the home of the [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Dhol]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], until Dhol hired the [[Guild of Vindicators]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Clat]] the Shamer to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] during a game of [[Firepath/Legends|firepath]]&mdash;Vader anticipated her treachery and killed them both.<ref name="DLC" /> Another J'feh, [[Skijid Vrescot]], ruled as the [[Count/Legends|Count]] of Cheelit during the later years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="vegas" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cheelit appeared in ''[[Dark Lord's Conscience]]'', a comic story written by [[Alan Moore]] and illustrated by [[John Stokes]], and originally released in [[1982]]'s [[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 155|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly'' 155]].<ref name="DLC" />
